variants.cost: Exactly one selected-arm observation per round, T over T rounds. Separately charge one K-coordinate simplex optimization and one categorical draw per round, maintenance of K-dimensional state and estimator arithmetic. No end-to-end arithmetic/bit-complexity bound or bounded Newton iteration count is supplied by the selected Theorem. Approximate optimization is not treated as free or automatically covered by the exact-update bound.
variants.implementation_details_ref: PDF p.7 Algorithm 1 lines 1–7; p.8 §3.2. Section 3.3 and Algorithm 2, pp.8–9, describe Newton approximation. Preserve Algorithm 1 timing with Lhat_(t-1). Algorithm 2 stops 'until convergence' without a quantified tolerance in the inspected text.
variants.name: Tsallis-INF IW, alpha=1/2, xi_i=1
variants.output: The online distribution w_t and sampled action I_t each round; performance concerns the incurred sequence of losses. No final best-arm identification output or recommendation guarantee is supplied.
public_inputs: Number of arms K, an integer at least 2
Current round index t; neither the horizon nor gaps nor the environment regime is needed
variants.query_and_update: At round t set eta_t=2/sqrt(t). Compute w_t=argmin_(w in Delta){<w,Lhat_(t-1)>+Psi(w)/eta_t}. Sample I_t according to w_t, observe and incur ell_t,I_t, and form ellhat_t,i=1{I_t=i} ell_t,I_t/w_t,i for each i. Update Lhat_t=Lhat_(t-1)+ellhat_t. Repeat. The square-root regularizer gives positive sampling probabilities for finite cumulative estimates, so IW divisions use positive probabilities.
variants.requirements: Loss vectors ell_t in [0,1]^K. The environment may depend on past actions and its own randomness, but does not select losses after seeing the current sampled action. Only the chosen arm's loss is required. The mathematical specification uses the exact regularized minimizer.
variants.state_and_initialization: Maintain Lhat_0=0 in R^K. Domain Delta={w in R^K: w_i>=0, sum_i w_i=1}. Set Psi(w)=-4 sum_i sqrt(w_i)+2 sum_i w_i and Psi_t(w)=Psi(w)/eta_t.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Fix alpha=1/2 and all xi_i=1; use eta_t=2/sqrt(t) for IW. Algorithm 1 runs indefinitely; evaluate or stop at any integer T>=1 without restarting or supplying T. No mixed-in exploration or gap estimates are part of this selected specification.
